composition_subtypes.role: Sort numbers descending to enable greedy selection of largest elements
Binary search to find max count of people who can be made wealthy
Greedy check: top m elements can be redistributed to all reach at least k

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort descending, then binary search over count m using prefix sums to check if top m can average at least k.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables greedy selection of richest; binary search finds max m where sum >= k*m, optimal by exchange argument.
